scope: Settings/HQ administration controllers and Onboard billing: literal routes with an explicit tenant-admin/HQ minimum role. The companion capability disposition covers externally managed and service-authorized Settings features.

classification.app-supported: An existing application consumer is present. This is source coverage, not deployment or live qualification.
classification.intentionally-api-only: Preserve the existing authorized API. A backend utility alone does not select a new product screen.
classification.externally-managed: The named external owner retains the operation; the app may link to it or display state.

limitations: Endpoint enumeration covers literal HTTP routes with an explicit minimum Roles requirement of user_admin or capiro_admin. Service-authorized and internal machine routes are represented by the Settings/utility capability records, not inferred as additional product scope.
Static consumer discovery records direct operation keys. It does not prove browser behavior or provider availability.
Objective Questions/Automation, Objective-to-Strategy-to-Planner workflow, and hub formulas remain deferred by the user.
No new administrative UI was selected by B14. Tenant audit viewing remains API-only. B12 managed-import delivery is a separate pending requirement.
